flags.question: Which game is the most commonly played among the top 5 streams by follower count?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game)
WITH g, s
ORDER BY s.followers DESC
LIMIT 5
RETURN g.name AS game, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 1
